name: Bustem GTM 1 visitor recovery
description: Event contract and decision rules used by the demo. Report delivery is a separate manual or verified integration event, never inferred from form submission.

actions.formAbandoned: Count drop-off; do not contact an anonymous visitor
actions.reportQuiet: Find public company contacts for review and prepare a report-specific follow-up draft
actions.returned: Remove the account from the quiet-report queue
actions.replied: Mark conversation and stop quiet-report follow-up

integrationPoints.landingAndForm: Send first-party events from the real website and form
integrationPoints.report: Record report_sent manually or from a verified report log with recipient, sent time, report URL, and finding
integrationPoints.enrichment: Replace public-site lookup with an approved data provider if available
integrationPoints.outreach: Review and send drafts through an approved CRM or email system
